name: Sae
source:
A domestic worker tasked as the exclusive caretaker of [url=https://vndb.org/c69402]Yukihito[/url].

Conditioned into submission and treated like a slave, even amidst the less-privileged women of her village, Sae has adopted a demeanor of timidity, respectfulness, and compliance to evade maltreatment.

[Translated from the [url=http://clockup.net/erewhon/character.html#char03]official website[/url]]
